s: Tlepolemos is a Herakleidai (ancestor of the ruling family and founder of the country)
q: Rhodes is said to have been colonised at the time of the Dorian migrations by Argive Dorians from Epidauros, who were Herakleidai of of the family of Tlepolemos.

l: The Extant Odes of Pindar
s: Tlepolemos has ancestry from Zeus (on the father's side)
q: For on the father's side they claim from Zeus, and on the mother's from Astydameia, sons of Amyntor.
